name: skillbench
description: A/B benchmark harness for measuring LLM agent rule-compliance under Context Engineering / Agent Skills

scripts.check: node src/check-arms.mjs && node scripts/check-spec.mjs && node scripts/check-spawn.mjs
scripts.pilot: node src/runner.mjs --adapter mock --reps 12 --out tmp/mock && node src/analyze.mjs --in tmp/mock/latest.json --out tmp/mock
scripts.dilution: node src/runner.mjs --adapter claude-cli --config config/dilution.json --scenarios S08,S09 --reps 15 && node scripts/dilution-report.mjs
scripts.results:all: node src/analyze.mjs && node scripts/make-results-doc.mjs && node scripts/make-slide-numbers.mjs && node scripts/check-numbers.mjs
scripts.check:acceptance: node scripts/check-acceptance.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance-green.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance-variants.mjs
scripts.gate: node src/check-arms.mjs && node scripts/check-spec.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance-green.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance-variants.mjs && node scripts/make-coverage-map.mjs && node scripts/make-arms-explained.mjs && node scripts/make-arms-review.mjs --check && node scripts/gate-analysis.mjs && node scripts/check-rcra-floor.mjs && node scripts/check-numbers.mjs
scripts.results:all:study2: npm run analyze:study2 && npm run results:doc:study2 && node scripts/check-numbers.mjs
